arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, time, resource, sys, os
start = time.time()
with open("/app/tmp/perf.json","rb") as f, open("/app/tmp/perf.out","wb") as o:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "entry.py"], stdin=f, stdout=o, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
el = time.time() - start
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("rc:", p.returncode, "wall: %.2fs" % el, "cpu: %.2fs" % (ru.ru_utime + ru.ru_stime), "maxrssMB:", ru.ru_maxrss/1024)
print("stderr:", p.stderr[:300])
print("out bytes:", os.path.getsize("/app/tmp/perf.out"))
EOF
